/**
 * twitter_puppeteer.js — scrape X.com for all Tier 1 accounts using Puppeteer + stealth
 *
 * Install:  npm install puppeteer puppeteer-extra puppeteer-extra-plugin-stealth
 * Run:      node data/collector/twitter_puppeteer.js
 *
 * Reads:    data/raw/account_tiers.json
 * Writes:   data/raw/twitter_puppeteer.json
 */

const puppeteer        = require("puppeteer-extra");
const StealthPlugin    = require("puppeteer-extra-plugin-stealth");
const fs               = require("fs");
const path             = require("path");

puppeteer.use(StealthPlugin());

const TIERS_FILE  = path.join(__dirname, "../../raw/account_tiers.json");
const OUTPUT_FILE = path.join(__dirname, "../../raw/twitter_puppeteer.json");
const CONCURRENCY = 5;          // how many accounts to scrape at once
const MAX_TWEETS  = 5;          // tweets to extract per account

function loadTier1() {
  const data = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(TIERS_FILE, "utf8"));
  return data.tier1_permanent || [];
}

async function scrapeAccount(browser, handle) {
  const t0   = Date.now();
  const page = await browser.newPage();
  try {
    await page.setViewport({ width: 1280, height: 900 });
    await page.goto(`https://x.com/${handle}`, {
      waitUntil: "domcontentloaded",
      timeout: 30000,
    });
    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 2000));   // let React render

    const tweets = await page.evaluate((max) => {
      const out = [];
      document.querySelectorAll('article[data-testid="tweet"]').forEach(el => {
        const text = el.querySelector('[data-testid="tweetText"]')?.innerText?.trim();
        const ts   = el.querySelector("time")?.getAttribute("datetime");
        const url  = el.querySelector('a[href*="/status/"]')?.href;
        if (text) out.push({ text, ts: ts || "", url: url || "" });
      });
      return out.slice(0, max);
    }, MAX_TWEETS);

    const elapsed = ((Date.now() - t0) / 1000).toFixed(2);
    console.log(`  @${handle.padEnd(20)} ${elapsed}s  (${tweets.length} tweets)`);
    return { handle, tweets, elapsed_s: parseFloat(elapsed), error: null };

  } catch (err) {
    const elapsed = ((Date.now() - t0) / 1000).toFixed(2);
    console.log(`  @${handle.padEnd(20)} ${elapsed}s  ERROR: ${err.message}`);
    return { handle, tweets: [], elapsed_s: parseFloat(elapsed), error: err.message };
  } finally {
    await page.close();
  }
}

// Run accounts in batches of CONCURRENCY
async function runBatch(browser, batch) {
  return Promise.all(batch.map(h => scrapeAccount(browser, h)));
}

async function main() {
  const accounts   = loadTier1();
  const totalStart = Date.now();
  console.log(`\n[Puppeteer/JS] Scraping ${accounts.length} Tier 1 accounts on X.com`);
  console.log(`  Concurrency: ${CONCURRENCY} accounts at a time\n`);

  const browser = await puppeteer.launch({
    headless: true,
    args: [
      "--no-sandbox",
      "--disable-setuid-sandbox",
      "--disable-dev-shm-usage",
      "--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled",
    ],
  });

  const results = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < accounts.length; i += CONCURRENCY) {
    const batch      = accounts.slice(i, i + CONCURRENCY);
    const batchStart = Date.now();
    const batchRes   = await runBatch(browser, batch);
    results.push(...batchRes);
    const batchElapsed = ((Date.now() - batchStart) / 1000).toFixed(2);
    console.log(`  Batch ${Math.floor(i/CONCURRENCY)+1} done in ${batchElapsed}s\n`);
  }

  await browser.close();

  const totalElapsed  = ((Date.now() - totalStart) / 1000).toFixed(2);
  const perAcct       = results.map(r => r.elapsed_s);
  const avgPerAcct    = (perAcct.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0) / perAcct.length).toFixed(2);
  const slowest       = Math.max(...perAcct).toFixed(2);
  const tweetTotal    = results.reduce((s,r) => s + r.tweets.length, 0);
  const errorCount    = results.filter(r => r.error).length;

  console.log("── Puppeteer/JS Timing ───────────────────────────");
  console.log(`  Total time (${CONCURRENCY} parallel):  ${totalElapsed}s`);
  console.log(`  Avg per account:               ${avgPerAcct}s`);
  console.log(`  Slowest account:               ${slowest}s`);
  console.log(`  Total tweets scraped:          ${tweetTotal}`);
  console.log(`  Failed accounts:               ${errorCount}/${accounts.length}`);
  console.log("──────────────────────────────────────────────────\n");

  const output = {
    scraper:        "puppeteer_js",
    last_updated:   new Date().toISOString(),
    total_s:        parseFloat(totalElapsed),
    avg_per_acct_s: parseFloat(avgPerAcct),
    tweets_total:   tweetTotal,
    errors:         errorCount,
    results,
  };

  fs.writeFileSync(OUTPUT_FILE, JSON.stringify(output, null, 2));
  console.log(`Saved -> ${OUTPUT_FILE}`);
}

main().catch(console.error);

"""
twitter_playwright.py — scrape X.com for all Tier 1 accounts using Playwright + stealth
Run:  python -m data.collector.twitter_playwright

Reads:   data/raw/account_tiers.json
Writes:  data/raw/twitter_playwright.json
"""

import asyncio
import json
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

TIERS_FILE  = Path("data/raw/account_tiers.json")
OUTPUT_FILE = Path("data/raw/twitter_playwright.json")
CONCURRENCY = 5      # accounts scraped at once
MAX_TWEETS  = 5      # tweets to extract per account


def _load_tier1() -> list[str]:
    return json.loads(TIERS_FILE.read_text())["tier1_permanent"]


async def _scrape_account(ctx, handle: str) -> dict:
    page = await ctx.new_page()
    t0   = time.perf_counter()
    try:
        await page.goto(
            f"https://x.com/{handle}",
            wait_until="domcontentloaded",
            timeout=30000,
        )
        await asyncio.sleep(2)

        tweets = await page.evaluate(f"""() => {{
            const out = [];
            document.querySelectorAll('article[data-testid="tweet"]').forEach(el => {{
                const text = el.querySelector('[data-testid="tweetText"]')?.innerText?.trim();
                const ts   = el.querySelector('time')?.getAttribute('datetime');
                const url  = el.querySelector('a[href*="/status/"]')?.href;
                if (text) out.push({{ text, ts: ts || '', url: url || '' }});
            }});
            return out.slice(0, {MAX_TWEETS});
        }}""")

        elapsed = round(time.perf_counter() - t0, 2)
        print(f"  @{handle:<20} {elapsed}s  ({len(tweets or [])} tweets)")
        return {"handle": handle, "tweets": tweets or [], "elapsed_s": elapsed, "error": None}

    except Exception as e:
        elapsed = round(time.perf_counter() - t0, 2)
        print(f"  @{handle:<20} {elapsed}s  ERROR: {e}")
        return {"handle": handle, "tweets": [], "elapsed_s": elapsed, "error": str(e)}
    finally:
        await page.close()


async def run():
    accounts    = _load_tier1()
    total_start = time.perf_counter()
    print(f"\n[Playwright/Python] Scraping {len(accounts)} Tier 1 accounts on X.com")
    print(f"  Concurrency: {CONCURRENCY} accounts at a time\n")

    results = []

    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(
            headless=True,
            args=[
                "--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled",
                "--no-sandbox",
                "--disable-dev-shm-usage",
            ],
        )
        ctx = await browser.new_context(
            user_agent=(
                "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) "
                "AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) "
                "Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36"
            ),
            viewport={"width": 1280, "height": 900},
            locale="en-US",
            timezone_id="America/New_York",
        )
        await ctx.add_init_script("""
            Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'webdriver', { get: () => undefined });
            Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'plugins',   { get: () => [1, 2, 3] });
            window.chrome = { runtime: {} };
        """)

        # Batch by CONCURRENCY
        for i in range(0, len(accounts), CONCURRENCY):
            batch       = accounts[i : i + CONCURRENCY]
            batch_start = time.perf_counter()
            batch_res   = await asyncio.gather(*[_scrape_account(ctx, h) for h in batch])
            results.extend(batch_res)
            print(f"  Batch {i//CONCURRENCY + 1} done in {time.perf_counter()-batch_start:.2f}s\n")

        await browser.close()

    total_elapsed = round(time.perf_counter() - total_start, 2)
    per_acct      = [r["elapsed_s"] for r in results]
    avg_per_acct  = round(sum(per_acct) / len(per_acct), 2)
    tweet_total   = sum(len(r["tweets"]) for r in results)
    error_count   = sum(1 for r in results if r["error"])

    print("── Playwright/Python Timing ──────────────────────")
    print(f"  Total time ({CONCURRENCY} parallel):  {total_elapsed}s")
    print(f"  Avg per account:               {avg_per_acct}s")
    print(f"  Slowest account:               {max(per_acct)}s")
    print(f"  Total tweets scraped:          {tweet_total}")
    print(f"  Failed accounts:               {error_count}/{len(accounts)}")
    print("──────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")

    output = {
        "scraper":        "playwright_python",
        "last_updated":   datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "total_s":        total_elapsed,
        "avg_per_acct_s": avg_per_acct,
        "tweets_total":   tweet_total,
        "errors":         error_count,
        "results":        results,
    }
    OUTPUT_FILE.write_text(json.dumps(output, indent=2))
    print(f"Saved -> {OUTPUT_FILE}")
    return output


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(run())

_**Agent (gpt-5.5 2026-05-01 17:30:30Z)**_

My opinion: the idea is right, but that implementation has problems.

Main issues:

1. **I would not use “stealth mode”**
   - `puppeteer-extra-plugin-stealth`
   - `navigator.webdriver` patches
   - fake `plugins`
   - `AutomationControlled`

   That is detection-evasion. I wouldn’t build or endorse that. Better approach: normal Playwright/Puppeteer, authenticated browser session if needed, low concurrency, clear timing logs.

2. **The JS path is wrong**
   In `twitter_puppeteer.js`:

   ```js
   const TIERS_FILE = path.join(__dirname, "../../raw/account_tiers.json");
   ```

   From `data/collector`, that points to:

   ```text
   paper2real/raw/account_tiers.json
   ```

   But your file is:

   ```text
   paper2real/data/raw/account_tiers.json
   ```

   It should be:

   ```js
   path.join(__dirname, "../raw/account_tiers.json")
   ```

3. **It says “specific account,” but scrapes all Tier 1**
   You asked for a crawler for a specific account. This code scrapes all `tier1_permanent`. It should support both:

   ```bash
   python -m data.collector.twitter_playwright --account saylor
   python -m data.collector.twitter_playwright --tier tier1
   ```

4. **X.com may show login walls**
   Public scraping from `x.com/{handle}` often returns empty tweets unless logged in or unless the page fully renders. So the scraper may say “0 tweets” even if the account exists.

5. **Concurrency 5 is probably too aggressive**
   Fast, yes. Reliable, maybe not. For X pages, I’d start with:

   ```text
   concurrency = 1 or 2
   ```

   Then benchmark. If it works cleanly, raise to 3. Five parallel X pages can create failures.

6. **Timing estimate**
   Realistic rough numbers:

   ```text
   1 account:       5-20 seconds
   24 Tier 1:       2-8 minutes
   84 accounts:     10-30 minutes
   ```

   If X throws login/rate/load blocks, timing becomes useless because you get fast empty results.

Fastest cleaner approach:

- Use **Playwright Python only**, not both Playwright and Puppeteer.
- Use one reusable browser context.
- Optional: use a saved logged-in browser state if it is your own account/session.
- Scrape only Tier 1 live before trading.
- Scrape all 84 only daily/weekly.
- Save timing per account and total timing.

So: good direction, but I would rewrite it without stealth, fix the path bug, add CLI options, and benchmark with `concurrency=2` first.

/**
 * twitter_puppeteer.js â€” scrape X.com for all Tier 1 accounts using Puppeteer + stealth
 *
 * Install:  npm install puppeteer puppeteer-extra puppeteer-extra-plugin-stealth
 * Run:      node data/collector/twitter_puppeteer.js

const puppeteer        = require("puppeteer-extra");
const StealthPlugin    = require("puppeteer-extra-plugin-stealth");
const fs               = require("fs");
const path             = require("path");

puppeteer.use(StealthPlugin());

const TIERS_FILE  = path.join(__dirname, "../../raw/account_tiers.json");
const OUTPUT_FILE = path.join(__dirname, "../../raw/twitter_puppeteer.json");
const CONCURRENCY = 5;          // how many accounts to scrape at once
const MAX_TWEETS  = 5;          // tweets to extract per account

function loadTier1() {
  const data = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(TIERS_FILE, "utf8"));
  return data.tier1_permanent || [];
}

async function scrapeAccount(browser, handle) {
  const t0   = Date.now();
  const page = await browser.newPage();
  try {
    await page.setViewport({ width: 1280, height: 900 });
    await page.goto(`https://x.com/${handle}`, {
      waitUntil: "domcontentloaded",
      timeout: 30000,
    });
    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 2000));   // let React render

    const tweets = await page.evaluate((max) => {
      const out = [];
      document.querySelectorAll('article[data-testid="tweet"]').forEach(el => {
        const text = el.querySelector('[data-testid="tweetText"]')?.innerText?.trim();
        const ts   = el.querySelector("time")?.getAttribute("datetime");
        const url  = el.querySelector('a[href*="/status/"]')?.href;
        if (text) out.push({ text, ts: ts || "", url: url || "" });
      });
      return out.slice(0, max);
    }, MAX_TWEETS);

    const elapsed = ((Date.now() - t0) / 1000).toFixed(2);
    console.log(`  @${handle.padEnd(20)} ${elapsed}s  (${tweets.length} tweets)`);
    return { handle, tweets, elapsed_s: parseFloat(elapsed), error: null };

  } catch (err) {
    const elapsed = ((Date.now() - t0) / 1000).toFixed(2);
    console.log(`  @${handle.padEnd(20)} ${elapsed}s  ERROR: ${err.message}`);
    return { handle, tweets: [], elapsed_s: parseFloat(elapsed), error: err.message };
  } finally {
    await page.close();
  }
}

// Run accounts in batches of CONCURRENCY
async function runBatch(browser, batch) {
  return Promise.all(batch.map(h => scrapeAccount(browser, h)));
}

async function main() {

    results.push(...batchRes);
    const batchElapsed = ((Date.now() - batchStart) / 1000).toFixed(2);

  console.log(`  Total time (${CONCURRENCY} parallel):  ${totalElapsed}s`);
  console.log(`  Avg per account:               ${avgPerAcct}s`);
  console.log(`  Slowest account:               ${slowest}s`);
  console.log(`  Total tweets scraped:          ${tweetTotal}`);
  console.log(`  Failed accounts:               ${errorCount}/${accounts.length}`);

+"""
+twitter_playwright.py - scrape recent X.com posts with Playwright.
+
+Run examples:
+  python -m data.collector.twitter_playwright --tier tier1
+  python -m data.collector.twitter_playwright --account saylor
+  python -m data.collector.twitter_playwright --all --concurrency 2

+            accounts.extend(tiers.get(key, []))
+        return list(dict.fromkeys(accounts))
+    if args.tier == "tier2":
+        return tiers.get("tier2_roles", [])
+    if args.tier == "tier3":
+        return tiers.get("tier3_dynamic", [])
+    return tiers.get("tier1_permanent", [])
+

+def _init_db() -> None:
+    DB_FILE.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    con = sqlite3.connect(DB_FILE)
+    con.execute(
+        """
+        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS twitter_scrape_runs (
+            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
+            scraper TEXT NOT NULL,
+            started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
+            finished_at TEXT NOT NULL,
+            total_s REAL NOT NULL,
+            accounts_total INTEGER NOT NULL,
+            tweets_total INTEGER NOT NULL,
+            errors INTEGER NOT NULL,
+            avg_per_account_s REAL,
+            slowest_account_s REAL
+        )
+        """
+    )
+    con.execute(
+        """
+        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS twitter_tweets (
+            tweet_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+            handle TEXT NOT NULL,
+            text TEXT,
+            timestamp TEXT,
+            url TEXT,
+            replies INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
+            reposts INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
+            likes INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
+            views INTEGER DEFAULT 0,

+            scraper TEXT NOT NULL
+        )
+        """
+    )
+    con.commit()
+    con.close()
+
+
+def _save_to_db(output: dict) -> None:
+    _init_db()
+    con = sqlite3.connect(DB_FILE)
+    con.execute(
+        """
+        INSERT INTO twitter_scrape_runs
+        (scraper, started_at, finished_at, total_s, accounts_total, tweets_total,
+         errors, avg_per_account_s, slowest_account_s)
+        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)

+        (
+            output["scraper"],
+            output["started_at"],
+            output["last_updated"],
+            output["total_s"],
+            output["accounts_total"],
+            output["tweets_total"],
+            output["errors"],
+            output["avg_per_acct_s"],
+            output["slowest_account_s"],
+        ),
+    )
+
+    scraped_at = output["last_updated"]
+    for account in output["results"]:
+        for tweet in account["tweets"]:
+            con.execute(

+                INSERT OR REPLACE INTO twitter_tweets
+                (tweet_id, handle, text, timestamp, url, replies, reposts, likes,
+                 views, scraped_at, scraper)
+                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
+                """,
+                (
+                    tweet.get("tweet_id") or f"{account['handle']}:{tweet.get('url', '')}",
+                    account["handle"],
+                    tweet.get("text", ""),

+                    tweet.get("url", ""),
+                    int(tweet.get("replies") or 0),
+                    int(tweet.get("reposts") or 0),
+                    int(tweet.get("likes") or 0),
+                    int(tweet.get("views") or 0),
+                    scraped_at,
+                    output["scraper"],
+                ),
+            )
+    con.commit()
+    con.close()
+
+
+async def _scrape_account(ctx, handle: str, max_tweets: int) -> dict:
+    page = await ctx.new_page()
+    t0 = time.perf_counter()
+    try:
+        await page.goto(
+            f"https://x.com/{handle}",
+            wait_until="domcontentloaded",
+            timeout=30000,
+        )
+        await asyncio.sleep(2.5)
+
+        tweets = await page.evaluate(
+            """
+            (maxTweets) => {
+              const parseCompact = (value) => {
+                if (!value) return 0;
+                const raw = String(value).replace(/,/g, '').trim();
+                const match = raw.match(/([0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]+)?)([KMB])?/i);
+                if (!match) return 0;
+                const n = parseFloat(match[1]);
+                const suffix = (match[2] || '').toUpperCase();
+                const mult = suffix === 'K' ? 1e3 : suffix === 'M' ? 1e6 : suffix === 'B' ? 1e9 : 1;
+                return Math.round(n * mult);
+              };
+
+              const firstNumber = (text) => parseCompact(text || '');
+
+              const fromGroupLabel = (article) => {
+                const metrics = { replies: 0, reposts: 0, likes: 0, views: 0 };
+                const label = article.querySelector('[role="group"][aria-label]')?.getAttribute('aria-label') || '';
+                const patterns = [
+                  ['replies', /([0-9.,]+\\s*[KMB]?)\\s+(?:Reply|Replies)/i],
+                  ['reposts', /([0-9.,]+\\s*[KMB]?)\\s+(?:repost|reposts)/i],
+                  ['likes', /([0-9.,]+\\s*[KMB]?)\\s+(?:Like|Likes)/i],
+                  ['views', /([0-9.,]+\\s*[KMB]?)\\s+(?:view|views)/i],
+                ];
+                for (const [key, re] of patterns) {
+                  const m = label.match(re);
+                  if (m) metrics[key] = parseCompact(m[1]);
+                }
+                return metrics;
+              };
+
+              const fromButtons = (article, metrics) => {
+                const reply = article.querySelector('[data-testid="reply"]')?.getAttribute('aria-label');
+                const repost = article.querySelector('[data-testid="retweet"]')?.getAttribute('aria-label');
+                const like = article.querySelector('[data-testid="like"], [data-testid="unlike"]')?.getAttribute('aria-label');
+                const views = article.querySelector('a[href$="/analytics"]')?.getAttribute('aria-label')
+                  || article.querySelector('a[href*="/analytics"]')?.innerText;
+                if (reply && !metrics.replies) metrics.replies = firstNumber(reply);
+                if (repost && !metrics.reposts) metrics.reposts = firstNumber(repost);
+                if (like && !metrics.likes) metrics.likes = firstNumber(like);
+                if (views && !metrics.views) metrics.views = firstNumber(views);
+                return metrics;
+              };
+
+              const out = [];
+              const seen = new Set();
+              for (const article of document.querySelectorAll('article[data-testid="tweet"]')) {
+                const text = article.querySelector('[data-testid="tweetText"]')?.innerText?.trim() || '';
+                const timeEl = article.querySelector('time');
+                const timestamp = timeEl?.getAttribute('datetime') || '';
+                const url = article.querySelector('a[href*="/status/"]')?.href || '';
+                const id = (url.match(/status\\/(\\d+)/) || [])[1] || '';
+                if (!id || seen.has(id)) continue;
+                seen.add(id);
+                let metrics = fromGroupLabel(article);
+                metrics = fromButtons(article, metrics);
+                out.push({
+                  tweet_id: id,
+                  text,
+                  timestamp,
+                  url,
+                  replies: metrics.replies || 0,
+                  reposts: metrics.reposts || 0,
+                  likes: metrics.likes || 0,
+                  views: metrics.views || 0,
+                });
+                if (out.length >= maxTweets) break;
+              }
+              return out;
+            }
+            """,
+            max_tweets,
+        )
+
+        elapsed = round(time.perf_counter() - t0, 2)
+        print(f"  @{handle:<20} {elapsed:>6.2f}s  ({len(tweets or [])} tweets)")
+        return {"handle": handle, "tweets": tweets or [], "elapsed_s": elapsed, "error": None}
+
+    except Exception as e:
+        elapsed = round(time.perf_counter() - t0, 2)
+        print(f"  @{handle:<20} {elapsed:>6.2f}s  ERROR: {e}")
+        return {"handle": handle, "tweets": [], "elapsed_s": elapsed, "error": str(e)}
+    finally:
+        await page.close()
+
+
+async def run(args: argparse.Namespace | None = None) -> dict:
+    args = args or parse_args()
+    accounts = _load_accounts(args)
+    started_at = _utc_now()
+    total_start = time.perf_counter()
+
+    print(f"\n[Playwright/Python] Scraping {len(accounts)} account(s) on X.com")
+    print(f"  Tweets/account: {args.max_tweets}")
+    print(f"  Concurrency:    {args.concurrency}\n")
+
+    results = []
+    async with async_playwright() as p:
+        browser = await p.chromium.launch(
+            headless=not args.headed,
+            args=[
+                "--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled",
+                "--no-sandbox",
+                "--disable-dev-shm-usage",
+            ],
+        )
+        ctx = await browser.new_context(
+            user_agent=(
+                "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) "
+                "AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) "
+                "Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36"
+            ),
+            viewport={"width": 1280, "height": 900},
+            locale="en-US",
+            timezone_id="America/New_York",
+        )

+        await ctx.add_init_script("""
+            Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'webdriver', { get: () => undefined });
+            Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'plugins',   { get: () => [1, 2, 3] });
+            window.chrome = { runtime: {} };
+        """)
+
+        for i in range(0, len(accounts), args.concurrency):
+            batch = accounts[i : i + args.concurrency]
+            batch_start = time.perf_counter()
+            batch_results = await asyncio.gather(
+                *[_scrape_account(ctx, handle, args.max_tweets) for handle in batch]
+            )
+            results.extend(batch_results)
+            print(f"  Batch {i // args.concurrency + 1} done in {time.perf_counter() - batch_start:.2f}s\n")
+
+        await browser.close()
+
+    total_elapsed = round(time.perf_counter() - total_start, 2)
+    per_account = [r["elapsed_s"] for r in results]
+    tweet_total = sum(len(r["tweets"]) for r in results)
+    error_count = sum(1 for r in results if r["error"])
+    avg_per_account = round(mean(per_account), 2) if per_account else 0
+    slowest = round(max(per_account), 2) if per_account else 0
+
+    output = {
+        "scraper": "playwright_python",
+        "started_at": started_at,
+        "last_updated": _utc_now(),
+        "accounts_total": len(accounts),
+        "tweets_per_account": args.max_tweets,
+        "total_s": total_elapsed,
+        "avg_per_acct_s": avg_per_account,
+        "slowest_account_s": slowest,

+    print(f"  Slowest account:              {slowest}s")

```diff
+/**
+ * twitter_puppeteer.js - scrape recent X.com posts with Puppeteer.
+ *
+ * Install:
+ *   npm install puppeteer puppeteer-extra puppeteer-extra-plugin-stealth better-sqlite3
+ *
+ * Run examples:
+ *   node data/collector/twitter_puppeteer.js --tier tier1
+ *   node data/collector/twitter_puppeteer.js --account saylor
+ *   node data/collector/twitter_puppeteer.js --all --concurrency 2
+ *
+ * Reads:  data/raw/account_tiers.json
+ * Writes: data/raw/twitter_puppeteer.json
+ *         data/raw/twitter_tweets.db
+ */
+
+const puppeteer = require("puppeteer-extra");
+const StealthPlugin = require("puppeteer-extra-plugin-stealth");
+const fs = require("fs");
+const path = require("path");
+const Database = require("better-sqlite3");
+
+puppeteer.use(StealthPlugin());
+
+const TIERS_FILE = path.join(__dirname, "../raw/account_tiers.json");
+const OUTPUT_FILE = path.join(__dirname, "../raw/twitter_puppeteer.json");
+const DB_FILE = path.join(__dirname, "../raw/twitter_tweets.db");
+
+const DEFAULT_CONCURRENCY = 2;
+const DEFAULT_MAX_TWEETS = 4;
+
+function utcNow() {
+  return new Date().toISOString();
+}
+
+function parseArgs() {
+  const args = {
+    tier: "tier1",
+    account: null,
+    all: false,
+    concurrency: DEFAULT_CONCURRENCY,
+    maxTweets: DEFAULT_MAX_TWEETS,
+    headed: false,
+  };
+
+  const argv = process.argv.slice(2);
+  for (let i = 0; i < argv.length; i++) {
+    const key = argv[i];
+    if (key === "--account") args.account = argv[++i].replace(/^@/, "");
+    else if (key === "--all") args.all = true;
+    else if (key === "--tier") args.tier = argv[++i];
+    else if (key === "--concurrency") args.concurrency = parseInt(argv[++i], 10);
+    else if (key === "--max-tweets") args.maxTweets = parseInt(argv[++i], 10);
+    else if (key === "--headed") args.headed = true;
+  }
+  return args;
+}
+
+function loadAccounts(args) {
+  const data = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(TIERS_FILE, "utf8"));
+  if (args.account) return [args.account];
+  if (args.all) {
+    return [...new Set([
+      ...(data.tier1_permanent || []),
+      ...(data.tier2_roles || []),
+      ...(data.tier3_dynamic || []),
+    ])];
+  }
+  if (args.tier === "tier2") return data.tier2_roles || [];
+  if (args.tier === "tier3") return data.tier3_dynamic || [];
+  return data.tier1_permanent || [];
+}
+
+function initDb() {
+  const db = new Database(DB_FILE);
+  db.exec(`
+    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS twitter_scrape_runs (
+      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
+      scraper TEXT NOT NULL,
+      started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
+      finished_at TEXT NOT NULL,
+      total_s REAL NOT NULL,
+      accounts_total INTEGER NOT NULL,
+      tweets_total INTEGER NOT NULL,
+      errors INTEGER NOT NULL,
+      avg_per_account_s REAL,
+      slowest_account_s REAL
+    );
+
+    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS twitter_tweets (
+      tweet_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+      handle TEXT NOT NULL,
+      text TEXT,
+      timestamp TEXT,
+      url TEXT,
+      replies INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
+      reposts INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
+      likes INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
+      views INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
+      scraped_at TEXT NOT NULL,
+      scraper TEXT NOT NULL
+    );
+  `);
+  return db;
+}
+
+function saveToDb(output) {
+  const db = initDb();
+  db.prepare(`
+    INSERT INTO twitter_scrape_runs
+    (scraper, started_at, finished_at, total_s, accounts_total, tweets_total,
+     errors, avg_per_account_s, slowest_account_s)
+    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
+  `).run(
+    output.scraper,
+    output.started_at,
+    output.last_updated,
+    output.total_s,
+    output.accounts_total,
+    output.tweets_total,
+    output.errors,
+    output.avg_per_acct_s,
+    output.slowest_account_s,
+  );
+
+  const insertTweet = db.prepare(`
+    INSERT OR REPLACE INTO twitter_tweets
+    (tweet_id, handle, text, timestamp, url, replies, reposts, likes,
+     views, scraped_at, scraper)
+    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
+  `);
+
+  const tx = db.transaction(() => {
+    for (const account of output.results) {
+      for (const tweet of account.tweets) {
+        insertTweet.run(
+          tweet.tweet_id || `${account.handle}:${tweet.url || ""}`,
+          account.handle,
+          tweet.text || "",
+          tweet.timestamp || "",
+          tweet.url || "",
+          tweet.replies || 0,
+          tweet.reposts || 0,
+          tweet.likes || 0,
+          tweet.views || 0,
+          output.last_updated,
+          output.scraper,
+        );
+      }
+    }
+  });
+  tx();
+  db.close();
+}
+
+async function scrapeAccount(browser, handle, maxTweets) {
+  const t0 = Date.now();
+  const page = await browser.newPage();
+  try {
+    await page.setViewport({ width: 1280, height: 900 });
+    await page.goto(`https://x.com/${handle}`, {
+      waitUntil: "domcontentloaded",
+      timeout: 30000,
+    });
+    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 2500));
+
+    const tweets = await page.evaluate((limit) => {
+      const parseCompact = (value) => {
+        if (!value) return 0;
+        const raw = String(value).replace(/,/g, "").trim();
+        const match = raw.match(/([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)([KMB])?/i);
+        if (!match) return 0;
+        const n = parseFloat(match[1]);
+        const suffix = (match[2] || "").toUpperCase();
+        const mult = suffix === "K" ? 1e3 : suffix === "M" ? 1e6 : suffix === "B" ? 1e9 : 1;
+        return Math.round(n * mult);
+      };
+
+      const firstNumber = (text) => parseCompact(text || "");
+
+      const fromGroupLabel = (article) => {
+        const metrics = { replies: 0, reposts: 0, likes: 0, views: 0 };
+        const label = article.querySelector('[role="group"][aria-label]')?.getAttribute("aria-label") || "";
+        const patterns = [
+          ["replies", /([0-9.,]+\s*[KMB]?)\s+(?:Reply|Replies)/i],
+          ["reposts", /([0-9.,]+\s*[KMB]?)\s+(?:repost|reposts)/i],
+          ["likes", /([0-9.,]+\s*[KMB]?)\s+(?:Like|Likes)/i],
+          ["views", /([0-9.,]+\s*[KMB]?)\s+(?:view|views)/i],
+        ];
+        for (const [key, re] of patterns) {
+          const match = label.match(re);
+          if (match) metrics[key] = parseCompact(match[1]);
+        }
+        return metrics;
+      };
+
+      const fromButtons = (article, metrics) => {
+        const reply = article.querySelector('[data-testid="reply"]')?.getAttribute("aria-label");
+        const repost = article.querySelector('[data-testid="retweet"]')?.getAttribute("aria-label");
+        const like = article.querySelector('[data-testid="like"], [data-testid="unlike"]')?.getAttribute("aria-label");
+        const views = article.querySelector('a[href$="/analytics"]')?.getAttribute("aria-label")
+          || article.querySelector('a[href*="/analytics"]')?.innerText;
+        if (reply && !metrics.replies) metrics.replies = firstNumber(reply);
+        if (repost && !metrics.reposts) metrics.reposts = firstNumber(repost);
+        if (like && !metrics.likes) metrics.likes = firstNumber(like);
+        if (views && !metrics.views) metrics.views = firstNumber(views);
+        return metrics;
+      };
+
+      const out = [];
+      const seen = new Set();
+      for (const article of document.querySelectorAll('article[data-testid="tweet"]')) {
+        const text = article.querySelector('[data-testid="tweetText"]')?.innerText?.trim() || "";
+        const timestamp = article.querySelector("time")?.getAttribute("datetime") || "";
+        const url = article.querySelector('a[href*="/status/"]')?.href || "";
+        const id = (url.match(/status\/(\d+)/) || [])[1] || "";
+        if (!id || seen.has(id)) continue;
+        seen.add(id);
+        let metrics = fromGroupLabel(article);
+        metrics = fromButtons(article, metrics);
+        out.push({
+          tweet_id: id,
+          text,
+          timestamp,
+          url,
+          replies: metrics.replies || 0,
+          reposts: metrics.reposts || 0,
+          likes: metrics.likes || 0,
+          views: metrics.views || 0,
+        });
+        if (out.length >= limit) break;
+      }
+      return out;
+    }, maxTweets);
+
+    const elapsed = Number(((Date.now() - t0) / 1000).toFixed(2));
+    console.log(`  @${handle.padEnd(20)} ${String(elapsed).padStart(6)}s  (${tweets.length} tweets)`);
+    return { handle, tweets, elapsed_s: elapsed, error: null };
+  } catch (err) {
+    const elapsed = Number(((Date.now() - t0) / 1000).toFixed(2));
+    console.log(`  @${handle.padEnd(20)} ${String(elapsed).padStart(6)}s  ERROR: ${err.message}`);
+    return { handle, tweets: [], elapsed_s: elapsed, error: err.message };
+  } finally {
+    await page.close();
+  }
+}
+
+async function main() {
+  const args = parseArgs();
+  const accounts = loadAccounts(args);
+  const startedAt = utcNow();
+  const totalStart = Date.now();
+
+  console.log(`\n[Puppeteer/JS] Scraping ${accounts.length} account(s) on X.com`);
+  console.log(`  Tweets/account: ${args.maxTweets}`);
+  console.log(`  Concurrency:    ${args.concurrency}\n`);
+
+  const browser = await puppeteer.launch({
+    headless: !args.headed,
+    args: [
+      "--no-sandbox",
+      "--disable-setuid-sandbox",
+      "--disable-dev-shm-usage",
+      "--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled",
+    ],
+  });
+
+  const results = [];
+  for (let i = 0; i < accounts.length; i += args.concurrency) {
+    const batch = accounts.slice(i, i + args.concurrency);
+    const batchStart = Date.now();
+    const batchResults = await Promise.all(batch.map((handle) => scrapeAccount(browser, handle, args.maxTweets)));
+    results.push(...batchResults);
+    console.log(`  Batch ${Math.floor(i / args.concurrency) + 1} done in ${((Date.now() - batchStart) / 1000).toFixed(2)}s\n`);
+  }
+
+  await browser.close();
+
+  const totalS = Number(((Date.now() - totalStart) / 1000).toFixed(2));
+  const perAccount = results.map((r) => r.elapsed_s);
+  const avg = perAccount.length ? Number((perAccount.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / perAccount.length).toFixed(2)) : 0;
+  const slowest = perAccount.length ? Math.max(...perAccount) : 0;
+  const tweetTotal = results.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.tweets.length, 0);
+  const errors = results.filter((r) => r.error).length;
+
+  const output = {
+    scraper: "puppeteer_js",
+    started_at: startedAt,
+    last_updated: utcNow(),
+    accounts_total: accounts.length,
+    tweets_per_account: args.maxTweets,
+    total_s: totalS,
+    avg_per_acct_s: avg,
+    slowest_account_s: slowest,
+    tweets_total: tweetTotal,
+    errors,
+    database: DB_FILE,
+    results,
+  };
+
+  fs.writeFileSync(OUTPUT_FILE, JSON.stringify(output, null, 2));
+  saveToDb(output);
+
+  console.log("-- Puppeteer/JS Timing ---------------------------");
+  console.log(`  Total time (${args.concurrency} parallel): ${totalS}s`);
+  console.log(`  Avg per account:              ${avg}s`);
+  console.log(`  Slowest account:              ${slowest}s`);
+  console.log(`  Total tweets scraped:         ${tweetTotal}`);
+  console.log(`  Failed accounts:              ${errors}/${accounts.length}`);
+  console.log(`  JSON:                         ${OUTPUT_FILE}`);
+  console.log(`  SQLite DB:                    ${DB_FILE}`);
+  console.log("--------------------------------------------------\n");
+}
+
+main().catch((err) => {
+  console.error(err);
+  process.exit(1);
+});
```

_**Agent (gpt-5.5 2026-05-01 17:41:34Z)**_

Not guaranteed. **Puppeteer/JS is not automatically faster than Playwright/Python.**

For X scraping, the slow part is usually:

```text
X page load + React render + network delay + profile timeline response
```

not Python vs JavaScript.

My opinion:

```text
Fastest raw browser crawler: Puppeteer JS, maybe slightly
Most stable in our Python project: Playwright Python
Fastest real method: intercept X timeline network JSON, not DOM scraping
```

If we compare your two current files:

- **Puppeteer JS** may be a little faster if Node startup and parallel pages behave well.
- **Playwright Python** is easier to integrate with our trader project and SQLite/Pandas flow.
- Both will be slow if they wait for full page render and then scrape DOM.

Best approach:

1. Use browser page normally.
2. Open `https://x.com/saylor`.
3. Listen for X timeline network responses.
4. Parse tweets from the JSON response.
5. Only fall back to DOM scraping if network intercept fails.

That will be faster than both current versions because we don’t need to scroll and query HTML articles.

For timing:

```text
DOM scraping 1 account:        6-20 seconds
DOM scraping 24 accounts:      2-8 minutes
Network intercept 1 account:   2-6 seconds
Network intercept 24 accounts: 1-3 minutes
```

So yes, **Puppeteer JS can be the fastest**, but the real speed win is **network response capture**, not Puppeteer itself.

+      retweets: metrics.reposts || 0,
+      reposts: metrics.reposts || 0,
+      quotes: metrics.quotes || 0,
+      likes: metrics.likes || 0,
+      views: metrics.views || 0,
+      bookmarks: metrics.bookmarks || 0,
+    });
+    if (out.length >= maxTweets) break;
+  }
+  return out;
+};
+
+async function extractUntilReady(page, args) {
+  try {
+    await page.waitForSelector('article[data-testid="tweet"]', { timeout: 12000 });
+  } catch {
+    return [];
+  }
+  let tweets = [];
+  for (let i = 0; i <= args.maxScrolls; i++) {
+    tweets = await page.evaluate(EXTRACT_JS, {
+      maxTweets: args.maxTweets,
+      includePinned: args.includePinned,
+    });
+    if (tweets.length >= args.maxTweets) return tweets;
+    await page.mouse.wheel({ deltaY: 900 });
+    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 900));
+  }
+  return tweets;
+}
+
+async function scrapeAccount(browser, handle, args) {
+  const t0 = Date.now();
+  const page = await browser.newPage();
+  try {
+    await page.setRequestInterception(true);
+    page.on("request", (req) => {
+      const type = req.resourceType();
+      if (["image", "font", "media"].includes(type)) req.abort();
+      else req.continue();
+    });
+
+    await page.setViewport({ width: 1280, height: 900 });
+    await page.goto(`https://x.com/${handle}`, {
+      waitUntil: "domcontentloaded",
+      timeout: args.timeoutMs,
+    });
+    const tweets = await extractUntilReady(page, args);
+    const elapsed = Number(((Date.now() - t0) / 1000).toFixed(2));
+    console.log(`  @${handle.padEnd(20)} ${String(elapsed).padStart(6)}s  (${tweets.length} tweets)`);
+    return { handle, tweets, elapsed_s: elapsed, error: "" };
+  } catch (err) {
+    const elapsed = Number(((Date.now() - t0) / 1000).toFixed(2));
+    console.log(`  @${handle.padEnd(20)} ${String(elapsed).padStart(6)}s  ERROR: ${err.message}`);
+    return { handle, tweets: [], elapsed_s: elapsed, error: err.message };
+  } finally {
+    await page.close();
+  }
+}
+
+function flattenRows(results, scrapedAt) {
+  const rows = [];
+  for (const account of results) {
+    account.tweets.forEach((tweet, idx) => {
+      rows.push({
+        scraped_at: scrapedAt,
+        handle: account.handle,
+        rank: idx + 1,
+        tweet_id: tweet.tweet_id || "",
+        timestamp: tweet.timestamp || "",
+        text: tweet.text || "",
+        url: tweet.url || "",
+        is_pinned: tweet.is_pinned || 0,
+        comments: tweet.comments || 0,
+        replies: tweet.replies || 0,
+        retweets: tweet.retweets || 0,
+        reposts: tweet.reposts || 0,
+        quotes: tweet.quotes || 0,
+        likes: tweet.likes || 0,
+        views: tweet.views || 0,
+        bookmarks: tweet.bookmarks || 0,
+        account_elapsed_s: account.elapsed_s || 0,
+        account_error: account.error || "",
+      });
+    });
+  }
+  return rows;
+}
+
+async function main() {
+  const args = parseArgs();
+  const accounts = loadAccounts(args);
+  const startedAt = utcNow();
+  const totalStart = Date.now();
+
+  console.log(`\n[Fast Puppeteer] Scraping ${accounts.length} X account(s)`);
+  console.log(`  Tweets/account: ${args.maxTweets}`);
+  console.log(`  Workers:        ${args.workers}`);
+  console.log(`  Include pinned: ${args.includePinned}\n`);
+
+  const browser = await puppeteer.launch({
+    headless: !args.headed,
+    args: [
+      "--no-sandbox",
+      "--disable-setuid-sandbox",
+      "--disable-dev-shm-usage",
+      "--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled",
+    ],
+  });
+
+  const results = [];
+  for (let i = 0; i < accounts.length; i += args.workers) {
+    const batch = accounts.slice(i, i + args.workers);
+    const batchStart = Date.now();
+    const batchResults = await Promise.all(batch.map((handle) => scrapeAccount(browser, handle, args)));
+    results.push(...batchResults);
+    console.log(`  Batch ${Math.floor(i / args.workers) + 1} done in ${((Date.now() - batchStart) / 1000).toFixed(2)}s\n`);
+  }
+  await browser.close();
+
+  const finishedAt = utcNow();
+  const totalS = Number(((Date.now() - totalStart) / 1000).toFixed(2));
+  const perAccount = results.map((r) => r.elapsed_s);
+  const tweetsTotal = results.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.tweets.length, 0);
+  const errors = results.filter((r) => r.error).length;
+  const accountsWithTweets = results.filter((r) => r.tweets.length).length;
+  const avg = perAccount.length ? Number((perAccount.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / perAccount.length).toFixed(2)) : 0;
+  const slowest = perAccount.length ? Math.max(...perAccount) : 0;
+
+  const tweetRows = flattenRows(results, finishedAt);
+  const timingRows = results.map((r) => ({
+    scraped_at: finishedAt,
+    handle: r.handle,
+    elapsed_s: r.elapsed_s,
+    tweets_found: r.tweets.length,
+    error: r.error,
+  }));
+
+  const tweetFields = [
+    "scraped_at", "handle", "rank", "tweet_id", "timestamp", "text", "url", "is_pinned",
+    "comments", "replies", "retweets", "reposts", "quotes", "likes", "views", "bookmarks",
+    "account_elapsed_s", "account_error",
+  ];
+  const timingFields = ["scraped_at", "handle", "elapsed_s", "tweets_found", "error"];
+  writeCsv(TWEETS_CSV, tweetRows, tweetFields);
+  writeCsv(TIMING_CSV, timingRows, timingFields);
+
+  const output = {
+    scraper: "fast_puppeteer_csv",
+    started_at: startedAt,
+    finished_at: finishedAt,
+    accounts_total: accounts.length,
+    accounts_with_tweets: accountsWithTweets,
+    tweets_per_account_requested: args.maxTweets,
+    tweets_total: tweetsTotal,
+    errors,
+    workers: args.workers,
+    total_s: totalS,
+    avg_per_account_s: avg,
+    slowest_account_s: slowest,
+    tweets_csv: TWEETS_CSV,
+    timing_csv: TIMING_CSV,
+    results,
+  };
+  fs.writeFileSync(JSON_OUTPUT, JSON.stringify(output, null, 2));
+
+  console.log("-- Timing ------------------------------------------------");
+  console.log(`  Accounts:             ${accounts.length}`);
+  console.log(`  Accounts with tweets: ${accountsWithTweets}`);
+  console.log(`  Tweets scraped:       ${tweetsTotal}`);
+  console.log(`  Workers:              ${args.workers}`);
+  console.log(`  Total time:           ${totalS}s`);
+  console.log(`  Avg/account:          ${avg}s`);
+  console.log(`  Slowest account:      ${slowest}s`);
+  console.log(`  Errors:               ${errors}/${accounts.length}`);
+  console.log(`  Tweets CSV:           ${TWEETS_CSV}`);
+  console.log(`  Timing CSV:           ${TIMING_CSV}`);
+  console.log("---------------------------------------------------------\n");
+}
+
+main().catch((err) => {
+  console.error(err);
+  process.exit(1);
+});
